svg.title: Figure FC-1. California axle weights and kingpin-to-rear-axle distance
svg.desc: Side view of a 5-axle tractor-semitrailer showing a steer axle, drive tandem, and trailer tandem with example weights of about 12,000, 34,000 and 34,000 pounds. A red dimension shows the 40-foot kingpin-to-rearmost-axle limit and a blue dimension shows the 36-foot tandem spread.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure FC-1. California axle weights and kingpin-to-rear-axle distance

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Kingpin to rearmost axle: 40 ft max (2+ axles), 38 ft (1 axle) — CVC 35400

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: First drive axle to last trailer axle: 36 ft or more for 34,000 + 34,000 — CVC 35551(b)

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • Any one axle: 20,000 lb; one end of an axle: 10,500 lb (CVC 35550).

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • Example: 12,000 + 34,000 + 34,000 = 80,000 lb gross (5 axles need 51 ft+ spread for 80,000 in the CVC 35551 table).

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • Off the Interstate/qualified routes: 65 ft overall combination limit (CVC 35401); 53-ft trailers need the 40-ft KPRA (CVC 35401.5).

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • Weight limits include all enforcement tolerances (CVC 35551(e)).
